items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Tony came in with the spiritual or the concerts -- spiritual concerts -- and he did very well.

ctx.x: Tony came in with the spiritual or the concerts -- spiritual concerts -- and he did very well. He fitted -- fit that format very well, but for some reason they come and they go. I guess -- if it isn't money, it's to a better and more advantageous position, but they go.

And Tony's first appearance with the band was at San Francisco in Grace Cathedral, at the first sacred concert in 1965. (Unintelligible) He was 16 years old, and he came in to and sang The Lord's Prayer and then left. Eventually he joined the (Unintelligible) band and sang part of the time and was band boy part of the time.
